the_committed_result_is_not_rewritten: data/results/closure_cell_inventory.json is opened read-only by this lane and stands exactly as committed on 2026-10-10. This file is additive and carries both values of every figure it touches.

which_quantity_each_is.what_the_committed_figures_are: a reading of this machine's distilled DepMap cache, data/knowledge/closure_cell/depmap_k562_gene_effect.json.gz, at the moment the census was written. `closure_cell.k562_gene_effect` returns the cache's ACCUMULATED UNION whenever the genes a run asks for are already covered -- the whole cached record comes back, `requested` included -- and the census writes these three fields from `len(held['requested'])`, `len(held['values'])` and `len(held['missing'])`.
which_quantity_each_is.what_the_field_names_claim: a count over the genes THIS census asked DepMap about.
which_quantity_each_is.and_it_is_unchanged: dependency.genes_asked, against the genes the census' own population implies: no number moves -- all 1 recomputed leaves equal the committed ones, and neither side carries a leaf the other does not

why_the_cache_grew.reading: `closure_cell2_inventory`, written later the same day, asked for more genes through the same persisted file, and its own record carries the three numbers the cache now holds.
why_the_cache_grew.the_sibling_named_the_defect_first: the two counts named genes_with_a_value and genes_absent_from_the_release are over the CACHE, which is reused between runs and holds more genes for K562 (M3's census asked about them) than for HepG2; the three counts over this search's own gene set are the ones to compare between cells
why_the_cache_grew.what_was_never_done: nothing carried that note back to the census of the same morning, which is why a faithful rebuild of `closure_cell_inventory` from its manifest prints the larger figures into its `dependency` block.

what_does_not_change_and_is_measured_not.the_frozen_population: the frozen population the registration pins, row by row: no number moves -- all 622856 recomputed leaves equal the committed ones, and neither side carries a leaf the other does not
what_does_not_change_and_is_measured_not.every_dependency_call: the frozen population is compared row by row in the recount with `dependency_attributed` and `dependency_nearest` on every one of its 47,912 rows, and every leaf matches. No element's dependency label moves.
what_does_not_change_and_is_measured_not.reading: 35 and 5,427 are unchanged on the complete stores, and so is the positive control's 757. A recomputed count is what the complete stores give; it does not by itself overturn a registered reading, and no registered test was re-run.

this_is_not_the_input_shrink: the defect this lane was opened on is a declared input group that shrinks silently on a partial store. This is a different defect found on the way: three fields that are not a function of the declared inputs' content alone. It is reported, not repaired -- `genomeos/attribution/closure_cell.py` is not this lane's to change, and the repair is a decision for whoever owns M3.

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments
revision_stamps.reading: no revision race: both stamps record 0313c4d

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
